title: florn
emulation_note: Actors run their real code under florn's rules: an activation takes no logical time, there is no operating system, clock or network stack beneath the actor, and the world around it is simulated by florn. What you see proves how the actor's logic behaves under those rules, not its speed on real hardware or how a real network would behave.

go_back.title: Going back discards what came after
go_back.help: The run returns to the instant and executes forward from its nearest checkpoint. The interventions below were applied after it: they are undone, and listed under Interventions to re-apply or discard.

labs.title: Learning labs

files.title: Files
files.cache_note: What you open, save or import is kept in this browser as a cache, listed below; the file is the durable form.
files.replay_note: Replay executes the run again from its inputs and applies the recorded interventions at their instants; playback would only display a trace.
